item.title: Amidst Trump endorsement battle, Paxton and Cornyn fight over SAVE America Act
item.description: President Donald Trump has announced he will endorse a candidate in the Texas Senate primary runoff, and incumbent Sen. John Cornyn and challenger Attorney General Ken Paxton are sparring online about who is most likely to secure Trump's agenda.

item.description: CLOVIS, N.M. (KAMR/KCIT) — The Clovis Police Department announced that it will conduct sobriety checkpoints and DWI saturation patrols this month. item.title: Ballard Creek Fire burns over 400 acres near Matador
item.description: MOTLEY COUNTY, Texas -- According to the Texas A&M Forest Service, a wildfire near Matador burned over 400 acres Friday. The fire, dubbed the Ballard Creek Fire, was 60 percent contained, as of 5:32 p.m. Friday after burning 406 acres north of Matador. This is an ongoing situation. EverythingLubbock.com will provide updates when available.

item.title: Trump Accounts: IRS announces rules proposal for $1K payments
item.description: The IRS announced a series of proposed rules that would determine eligibility and timing for the $1,000 government seed payments, among other aspects of the Trump Accounts.

item.title: Family mourns the loss of mother and daughter killed in tornado
item.description: A family and community are devastated by the loss of 47-year-old Jodie and 13-year-old Lexi Owens. They were killed by a tornado in Major County on Thursday night.

item.title: 3 injured after driver allegedly runs red-light in downtown Amarillo
item.description: Emergency crews are on the scene of a wreck in downtown Amarillo that involved two cars, resulting in three people being injured Friday night.

item.title: Rising oil prices tied to Middle East tensions could impact Panhandle drivers
item.description: Rising tension in the Middle East are pushing global oil prices higher, and experts say that could soon affect what drivers and families pay across the Panhandle.
